label: Initiative 86
t: Ban force-feeding birds and foie gras sales
what: Prohibits force-feeding birds to enlarge their livers and bans the commercial sale, distribution and importation of foie gras and other fattened-liver products in D.C. The Department of Energy and Environment would enforce it during routine food-safety inspections.
y: Foie gras and other force-fed bird liver products can no longer be sold in D.C.
con: Some D.C. restaurateurs, e.g. chef Bart Hutchins (Butterworth's)
